boundedQuestion: Can N314 be bypassed after restart by resetting its trusted sequence state and rewinding its trusted clock, then replaying the entire old dispatch and attestation bundle?

vulnerableReplay.defect: N314 accepts state and now as ordinary caller inputs, so its freshness root can be reset and rewound by the same party presenting the replay.

teacherDecision.source: The Update Framework rollback/freeze protections already audited in N314
teacherDecision.novelty: None. N314 already states that trusted time and persisted version state must not be Producer-controlled. N315 is a transfer regression proving the prototype still accepts both as caller inputs.

boundary: Synthetic replay and signed-checkpoint prototype only. Real non-volatile pin storage, coordinator availability, crash recovery, checkpoint equivocation detection, key rotation, and one live Mother route remain UNKNOWN.
